summary: Pacific Airport Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the cessation of Spirit Airlines' operations and its impact on GAP's airports. Spirit did not operate at any GAP Mexican airports; in Jamaica, it represented ~3.5% of Kingston and ~2.6% of Montego Bay traffic on Florida routes with available capacity from other airlines. GAP holds no material exposure as Spirit's outstanding balances are fully covered by bank guarantees and cash deposits, ensuring no financial impact. No special situation event is disclosed.
